classification: Genuinely issued cloud experimental forecasts; not official forecasts, and not claimed issued by a later local Windows checkout.

summary.metric_cohort: First genuinely issued experimental forecast per game; future research should also compare fixed model-version/cutoff cohorts.
summary.note: Multiple forecasts per game are revisions, not independent games.
